features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to a shifted V2, capturing the relative magnitude between the first two features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to split directly on the non-linear relationship between V1 and V2, which would otherwise require deep, complex split paths.

features.name: v3_v4_diff
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-computed linear combination, saving the tree from having to approximate this diagonal split with multiple orthogonal splits.

features.name: v1_v2_v3_sum
features.description: Sum of the first three features, representing an overall magnitude or energy level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the tree a single feature to evaluate the combined strength of the primary variables, useful for broad thresholding.

features.name: v5_squared
features.description: Squared value of V5, emphasizing extreme deviations from zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps trees isolate high-magnitude outliers in V5 by stretching the scale for larger absolute values.

features.name: v1_above_mean_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator if V1 is above its training set mean (0.838).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong, immediate binary split point based on the central tendency of V1.

features.name: v2_v3_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between V2 and V3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the joint effect of V2 and V3, a non-linear surface that tree models cannot easily synthesize on their own.

features.name: v4_v5_max
features.description: The maximum value between V4 and V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies the dominant higher-order feature, allowing the tree to split on the most prominent signal among the two.

features.name: v1_v5_diff_abs
features.description: Absolute difference between the first and last features (V1 and V5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the divergence across the feature spectrum, providing a magnitude of difference that trees can threshold effectively.

features.name: v2_ordinal_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucketing of V2 into three categories: negative, below mean, and above mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the number of splits needed by pre-grouping V2 into meaningful ordinal ranges.

features.name: v3_shifted_log
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of V3 shifted by 1.5 to ensure positive values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the right tail of V3's distribution, making it easier for trees to create balanced splits across the feature's range.

features.name: v1_v2_harmonic_resonance_score
features.description: A semantic assessment of the harmonic resonance quality based on the relationship and magnitudes of the first two features (V1 and V2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of the lower-frequency components that might correlate with specific underlying physical or acoustic properties.

features.name: v3_v4_v5_spectral_complexity
features.description: Evaluates the spectral complexity and high-frequency energy distribution using the higher features (V3, V4, V5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, multi-variable patterns in the higher-order features that are difficult to express through simple deterministic formulas.
